chapter: Left out of the jazz books; Tatum, Handy and family
title: Elbert Topps band and Dan Grissom
summary: Collins confirms he first played with Elbert Topps, where his mother played and Dan Grissom was on saxophone.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: When you first joined Tatum you joined Tatum according to certain books straight from Albert B. Topps was it, is that right?
Oh, boy, do you know I forgot Albert?
Albert Topps, then Jimmie Bell, and then back to Elbert Topps. (inaudible)
Hey, Elbert Topps. My mother was playing with Elbert Topps, this is why I went with Elbert Topps. And Dan Grissom was playing saxophone. We played -- yeah, Dan Grissom was playing saxophone.
I know him as a singer. (inaudible)
But he played saxophone sometimes with Luncford, Lansfort.
